name: Keen Hunter (Combat)
body:
Your keen senses can give you an advantage in combat.

Prerequisite(s): Perception 1 rank, base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): As a standard action you may make a Perception check with a DC equal to an enemy’s armor class. If you succeed, until your next turn that enemy gains no bonus from flanking against you and you may move at half speed when leaving one of their threatened squares to avoid provoking an attack of opportunity.

This feat counts as Combat Expertise and Int 13 for the purposes of meeting feat prerequisites which include Combat Expertise.
